newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see little trade in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see little trade in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw little business this afternoon as many buyers were discouraged by pre-opning calls for a weaker Chicago soycomplex opening and a firmer dollar, market sources said.
The Chicago soycomplex was expected to ease on a bearishly interpreted USDA soybean crop estimate of 2.270 billion bushels.
"This morning everybody waited for the USDA figures and this afternoon there was little reason to enter the market as Chicago was expected to go down," one broker said.
Afloat citruspulp pellets traded at $109 and Oct/Dec at $115 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
